D: A hotshot lawyer is ordered to coach a team of misfit kids in peewee ice hockey.
P: Serve the snacks when the Ducks pull off the Flying V for the first time.
S: Cubes of firm mozzarella dipped in light batter and fried golden, with ranch for dipping. Cut 400g firm mozzarella into 2cm cubes. Whisk 1 cup self-raising flour with 250ml cold milk and a pinch of salt. Dip the cubes in the batter and fry in 5cm hot oil for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. Serve with ranch dressing.
Creamy chicken wild rice soup cups

Wild rice simmered with chicken, carrot, celery and onion in a creamy thyme stock, ladled into small cups with buttered bread fingers. Soften a diced onion, a carrot and 2 celery sticks in 30g butter. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 1.2L chicken stock, 120g wild rice blend and thyme. Add 400g chicken thighs and simmer 40 minutes until the rice is tender. Shred the chicken back in and stir through 150ml cream. Ladle into cups and serve with fingers of buttered toast.
Two thin beef patties sealed around a slice of cheese, griddled so the cheese melts inside, in slider buns with pickles.
M: Beef mince browned with onion, mixed with corn, green beans and a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with potato gems and baked at 200C for 35 minutes.

Beef and pork meatballs browned and simmered in a garlic and basil tomato sauce, served from a big pot over spaghetti with grated parmesan. Mix 300g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs, an egg, 30g grated parmesan, chopped parsley and salt. Roll into 24 balls and brown in olive oil. Add 3 crushed garlic cloves, then 2 cans crushed tomatoes and 200ml water. Simmer 30 minutes and stir in torn basil. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some sauce and top with the meatballs and more parmesan.
W: the skate shop owner who taught Gordon

Chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, topped with white chocolate icing smoothed like ice, cut into squares. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs and fold in 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Spread 150g melted white chocolate smooth over the top like ice and cut into squares.
K: the team before they became the Ducks

Dark chocolate melted into hot milk, whisked frothy, topped with marshmallows in big mugs. Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until frothy. Pour into big mugs and pile marshmallows on top. Ducks fly together.

Divide 700g beef mince into 16 thin patties. Sandwich half a slice of American cheese between 2 patties and pinch the edges sealed, making 8. Griddle 4 minutes a side, rest 2 minutes so the cheese doesn't burst, and serve in 8 slider buns with pickles.

m.how: Brown 600g beef mince with an onion and 200g mushrooms. Stir in 200g corn, 200g chopped green beans and 250ml cream. Tip into a dish, cover with 500g potato gems and bake at 200C for 35 minutes.
